owner_calls.question: Step 5 (X-Men: The Last Stand) marks the whole Brotherhood 'Deceased', but the film ends with Magneto alive, depowered and free in San Francisco, and Pyro and Juggernaut beaten but not killed. Only some of the rank-and-file are wiped out by the Phoenix. Which status should a defeated, scattered group get here?
options: Keep 'Deceased' (the group is finished as a force)
'At large' (its leader and surviving members are free at the end)
Another status the app uses for a group that has broken up
owner_calls.evidence: Plot: during the Alcatraz fight Kitty saves Jimmy from Juggernaut, Iceman beats Pyro, and McCoy injects Magneto with the cure. The final scene shows Magneto, seemingly powerless, at a chessboard in San Francisco, and a metal piece wobbles. No source says the group's members all die.
